        "contents": "# Music Playback Implementation - Complete\n\n## ✅ What Was Built\n\n### 1. **MusicTrack Model** (&#96;Models/MusicTrack.swift&#96;)\n- Represents a single music track with metadata\n- Converts from &#96;Asset&#96; model\n- Provides cleaned display names (removes .mp3, replaces underscores)\n- Includes &#96;RepeatMode&#96; enum (all, one, none)\n\n### 2. **MusicService** (&#96;Services/MusicService.swift&#96;)\n**Core Features:**\n- ✅ Fetches music playlist from server via AssetsService\n- ✅ Caches playlist to UserDefaults (24-hour validity)\n- ✅ Caches audio files to disk (&#96;Documents/MusicCache/&#96;)\n- ✅ Playback management with AVAudioPlayer\n- ✅ Shuffle mode (generates random queue)\n- ✅ Repeat mode (all, one, none)\n- ✅ Song selection (play specific song, then continue queue)\n- ✅ Game coordination (pauses when game starts, resumes when game ends)\n- ✅ Audio interruption handling (phone calls, etc.)\n- ✅ Settings persistence (shuffle, music on/off, current song)\n- ✅ Auto-play on startup if music enabled\n\n**Key Methods:**\n- &#96;loadPlaylist()&#96; - Fetch from server, cache locally\n- &#96;play()&#96; / &#96;pause()&#96; / &#96;stop()&#96; - Playback control\n- &#96;toggleMusic()&#96; - Enable/disable music\n- &#96;toggleShuffle()&#96; - Enable/disable shuffle\n- &#96;playSong(_:)&#96; - Play specific song\n- &#96;setGameActive(_:)&#96; - Coordinate with game lifecycle\n\n### 3. **SettingsView Updates** (&#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96;)\n**New Music Controls Section:**\n- ✅ Music On/Off toggle\n- ✅ Shuffle On/Off toggle\n- ✅ Song selector list with:\n  - Currently playing indicator (▶️ icon)\n  - Play/pause state display\n  - Tap to select and play song\n  - Highlighted current song\n\n### 4. **MainView Integration**\n- ✅ Game lifecycle coordination via &#96;.onChange(of: showWaypointGame)&#96;\n- ✅ Calls &#96;MusicService.shared.setGameActive()&#96; when game starts/ends\n\n### 5. **MainViewModel Integration**\n- ✅ Initializes &#96;MusicService.shared&#96; on app startup\n- ✅ Music service loads playlist automatically\n\n## 🎯 How It Works\n\n### Startup Flow:\n1. App launches → &#96;MainViewModel.init()&#96; → &#96;MusicService.shared&#96; created\n2. &#96;MusicService.init()&#96; → Checks cache → Loads playlist (cache or server)",

        "contents": "//\n//  MainViewModel.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\n\nenum GenerationButtonState: Sendable {\n    case notReady\n    case ready\n    case generating\n    \n    var id: Int {\n        switch self {\n        case .notReady: return 0\n        case .ready: return 1\n        case .generating: return 2\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nclass MainViewModel: ObservableObject {\n    private let apiClient = APIClient.shared\n    private let sseService = SSEService.shared\n    private let assetsService = AssetsService.shared\n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private var imageGenerationTask: Task&lt;Void, Never&gt;?\n    \n    // View mode - controls which layout is displayed\n    @Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default {\n        didSet {\n            // Persist view mode selection\n            UserDefaults.standard.set(viewMode.rawValue, forKey: \"viewMode\")\n            // Load style items when switching to fourCarousel mode\n            if viewMode == .fourCarousel &amp;&amp; styleItems.isEmpty {\n                loadStyleItems()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Carousel indices\n    @Published var friendIndex = -1\n    @Published var outfitIndex = -1\n    @Published var placeIndex = -1\n    @Published var styleIndex = -1 // For 4th carousel (style/medium)\n    \n    // Ingredients by category (filtered from API)\n    @Published var friendItems: [Ingredient] = []\n    @Published var outfitItems: [Ingredient] = []\n    @Published var placeItems: [Ingredient] = []\n    @Published var styleItems: [Ingredient] = [] // Placeholder style items\n    \n    // Preview and history\n    @Published var previewImage: UIImage?\n    @Published var historyImages: [GeneratedImage] = []\n    \n    // Background image\n    @Published var backgroundImage: UIImage?\n    \n    // Button state\n    @Published var buttonState: GenerationButtonState = .notReady\n    \n    // Loading states\n    @Published var isLoadingIngredients = false\n    @Published var isLoadingHistory = false\n    @Published var isCreatingImage = false",

        "contents": "# View Mode System - Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\nAdd a view mode selection system that allows switching between different main view layouts. Start with DEFAULT (current) and add a new 4-CAROUSEL mode with style selection.\n\n## Acceptance Criteria\n1. ✅ Default view works unchanged\n2. ✅ View mode selectable from Settings menu\n3. ✅ 4th carousel bottom-aligned with preview drawer\n4. ✅ 4th reference image included in generation when in 4-carousel mode\n5. ✅ GPT prompt modified to use style input\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step Implementation Plan\n\n### Phase 1: View Mode Infrastructure (Foundation)\n\n#### Step 1.1: Create View Mode Enum\n**File:** &#96;Models/ViewMode.swift&#96; (NEW)\n- Enum: &#96;ViewMode&#96; with cases:\n  - &#96;.default&#96; (current 3-carousel view)\n  - &#96;.fourCarousel&#96; (new 4-carousel view)\n- Make it &#96;Codable&#96; for persistence\n- Add &#96;displayName: String&#96; computed property\n\n#### Step 1.2: Add View Mode State to MainViewModel\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleIndex: Int = -1&#96; (for 4th carousel)\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleItems: [Ingredient] = []&#96; (placeholder styles)\n- Update &#96;allSelectionsReady&#96; computed property:\n  - Default mode: requires friend, outfit, place (3 selections)\n  - FourCarousel mode: requires friend, outfit, place, style (4 selections)\n\n#### Step 1.3: Persist View Mode Selection\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Save &#96;viewMode&#96; to UserDefaults on change\n- Load &#96;viewMode&#96; from UserDefaults in &#96;init()&#96;\n- Add &#96;func setViewMode(_ mode: ViewMode)&#96; method\n\n---\n\n### Phase 2: Settings UI (View Selection)\n\n#### Step 2.1: Add View Mode Selector to Settings\n**File:** &#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96;\n- Add new section: \"View Mode\" above Music Controls\n- Add &#96;@ObservedObject var viewModel: MainViewModel&#96; parameter\n- Create &#96;ViewModeSelector&#96; component:\n  - Shows current view mode",

        "contents": "# Standalone Minigame Pattern\n\n**Based on:** Waypoint Navigation Game  \n**Purpose:** Each minigame should be able to function as a standalone app OR be integrated into the main app\n\n---\n\n## Architecture Pattern\n\n### Key Principle: **Self-Contained Independence**\n\nEach minigame should be completely self-contained and not depend on the main app structure. It should work both:\n1. **Standalone:** As its own app (for testing/debugging)\n2. **Integrated:** As part of the main app (via fullScreenCover/sheet)\n\n---\n\n## File Structure Pattern\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nViews/\n  Minigames/\n    {GameName}/\n      {GameName}View.swift          // Main game view (self-contained)\n      {GameName}Canvas.swift        // SpriteKit/rendering (if needed)\n      {GameName}VictoryView.swift    // Victory sequence (if needed)\nViewModels/\n  {GameName}ViewModel.swift          // Game-specific view model\nModels/\n  {GameName}Models.swift            // Game-specific models\nServices/\n  {GameName}AudioService.swift      // Game-specific audio (if needed)\n{GameName}StandaloneApp.swift       // Standalone entry point\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Component Breakdown\n\n### 1. **Standalone App Entry Point**\n\n**File:** &#96;{GameName}StandaloneApp.swift&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n//\n//  {GameName}StandaloneApp.swift\n//  abbies.world.ios\n//\n//  Standalone entry point for {Game Name} Minigame\n//  This allows the game to run independently without the main app\n//\n//  NOTE: To run as standalone app:\n//  1. Temporarily comment out @main in abbies_world_iosApp.swift\n//  2. Uncomment @main below\n//  3. Or create a separate Xcode target for the standalone game\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\n// Uncomment the @main attribute below to run as standalone app\n// (and comment out @main in abbies_world_iosApp.swift)\n// @main\nstruct {GameName}StandaloneApp: App {\n    var body: some Scene {\n        WindowGroup {\n            {GameName}View()\n                .ignoresSafeArea()\n        }\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Key Points:**\n- Simple App struct that wraps the main game view\n- &#96;@main&#96; is commented out by default\n- Can be easily enabled for standalone testing",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "# Drawer Migration Plan: Two-Column to Full-Width with Overlay Drawer\n\n**Date:** December 2025  \n**Goal:** Migrate from 55%/45% split layout to full-width carousels with right-side overlay drawer\n\n---\n\n## Current State Analysis\n\n### Current Structure\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nMainView\n├── HStack (spacing: 0)\n│   ├── CombinedColumnView (55% width)\n│   │   └── 3 Carousels (Friend, Outfit, Place)\n│   └── RightColumnView (45% width)\n│       ├── Preview Section\n│       └── History Section\n└── Overlay (Settings/Games buttons, error dialogs)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Dependencies\n- &#96;RightColumnCalculations&#96; depends on &#96;LeftColumnCalculations&#96; for height matching\n- &#96;CombinedColumnView&#96; uses &#96;LeftColumnCalculations&#96; for carousel heights\n- Both views share the same &#96;GeometryReader&#96; context\n\n### Key Components to Modify\n1. **MainView.swift** - Layout structure (HStack → ZStack)\n2. **CombinedColumnView** - Width constraint (55% → 100%)\n3. **RightColumnView** - Convert to drawer content\n4. **New: DrawerView** - Drawer container with handle\n5. **New: DrawerHandle** - Semi-transparent handle component\n\n---\n\n## Migration Strategy: Incremental &amp; Safe\n\n### Phase 1: Foundation (Low Risk)\n**Goal:** Set up drawer structure without breaking existing layout\n\n#### Step 1.1: Create Drawer State Management\n- **File:** &#96;MainView.swift&#96;\n- **Action:** Add &#96;@State private var isDrawerOpen: Bool = false&#96;\n- **Risk:** None (new state, doesn't affect existing code)\n- **Test:** Verify app still runs normally\n\n#### Step 1.2: Create DrawerHandle Component\n- **File:** &#96;Views/Components/DrawerHandle.swift&#96; (new file)\n- **Action:** Create reusable drawer handle view\n- **Properties:**\n  - Semi-transparent background (30-40% opacity)\n  - Chevron icon (left-pointing when closed, right-pointing when open)\n  - Rounded rectangle shape\n  - Tap gesture to toggle drawer\n  - Subtle pulse animation when closed\n- **Risk:** None (new component, not integrated yet)\n- **Test:** Can instantiate and display in preview",

        "contents": "3. **Add interruption handlers** - Handle iOS system interruptions\n\n### Phase 2: Resilience (Reduce Medium Risks)\n4. **Cache-first strategy** - Work offline\n5. **Lazy caching** - Reduce storage impact\n6. **State validation** - Prevent corruption issues\n\n### Phase 3: Polish (Reduce Low Risks)\n7. **Comprehensive testing** - All edge cases\n8. **Error logging** - Debug issues in production\n9. **User feedback** - Clear error messages\n\n---\n\n## Risk Summary Matrix\n\n| Risk | Impact | Probability | Priority | Mitigation Effort |\n|------|--------|-------------|---------|-------------------|\n| Audio Session Conflicts | High | High | 🔴 Critical | Medium |\n| Memory Leaks | High | Medium-High | 🔴 Critical | Low |\n| Background Interruptions | Medium | Medium | 🟡 Medium | Medium |\n| Network Failures | Medium | Medium | 🟡 Medium | Low |\n| Storage Issues | Medium | Low-Medium | 🟡 Medium | Low |\n| State Persistence | Medium | Low-Medium | 🟡 Medium | Low |\n| Threading Issues | High | Low | 🟢 Low | Medium |\n| Battery Drain | Low | Low | 🟢 Low | Low |\n| Format Compatibility | Medium | Very Low | 🟢 Low | Low |\n| Playlist Bugs | Low | Low | 🟢 Low | Low |\n\n---\n\n## Recommended Implementation Order\n\n1. **AudioSessionManager** (Critical - do first)\n2. **MusicService with proper cleanup** (Core functionality)\n3. **Interruption handlers** (Critical for UX)\n4. **Cache-first loading** (Resilience)\n5. **Settings UI** (User-facing)\n6. **Error handling &amp;         "contents": "6. ✅ **Phase 6** - Prompt modification (style in prompt)\n\n---\n\n## Key Design Decisions\n\n### Simplicity First\n- Start with placeholder tiles (no images) - just visual proof\n- Use style name in prompt (not reference image) initially\n- Can add actual style reference images later\n\n### Backward Compatibility\n- Default mode unchanged - all existing code paths work\n- New mode is additive - doesn't break existing functionality\n- View mode is opt-in via Settings\n\n### Incremental Testing\n- Test each phase before moving to next\n- Verify default mode still works after each change\n- Test 4-carousel mode in isolation\n\n---\n\n## File Structure\n\n**New Files:**\n- &#96;Models/ViewMode.swift&#96;\n- &#96;Views/Components/StylePlaceholderTile.swift&#96;\n- &#96;Views/Components/FourCarouselView.swift&#96;\n\n**Modified Files:**\n- &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96; - Add view mode state, style items, generation logic\n- &#96;Views/MainView.swift&#96; - Conditional view rendering\n- &#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96; - Add view mode selector\n- &#96;Abbies World Server/src/game_engine.py&#96; - Style prompt handling (optional, Phase 6)\n\n---\n\n## Testing Checklist (Per Phase)\n\n**Phase 1:**\n- [ ] View mode enum compiles\n- [ ] View mode persists across app restarts\n- [ ] Default mode still works\n\n**Phase 2:**\n- [ ] Settings shows view mode selector\n- [ ] Can switch between modes\n- [ ] Main view updates when mode changes\n\n**Phase 3:**\n- [ ] Style items load correctly\n- [ ] Placeholder tiles render\n- [ ] Can select style items\n\n**Phase 4:**\n- [ ] FourCarouselView renders\n- [ ] 4th carousel appears at bottom\n- [ ] All 4 carousels are selectable\n- [ ] Drawer still works\n\n**Phase 5:**\n- [ ] Generation includes 4th reference when in 4-carousel mode\n- [ ] Generation still works in default mode (3 images)\n- [ ] Button state updates correctly\n\n**Phase 6:**\n- [ ] Generated images reflect style selection\n- [ ] Prompt includes style information\n- [ ] Default mode prompts unchanged\n\n---\n\n## Risk Mitigation\n\n1. **Default Mode Must Work** - Always test default mode after each change\n2. **Incremental Changes** - One phase at a time, test before proceeding",

        "contents": "| FindSpace | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 4-6h | Medium* |\n| enchantedforest | ⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 8-10h | Low |\n| Tracer3 | ⭐⭐⭐ | High | 12-16h | Low |\n\n*After fixing Phaser version\n\n---\n\n## Next Steps\n\n### Immediate Actions:\n\n1. **Choose First Game to Port**\n   - Recommended: **goonpopper** (simplest, high appeal)\n   - Or: **FindPrincess** (establishes Find game pattern)\n\n2. **Set Up Asset Structure**\n   - Create server directories\n   - Upload assets for chosen game\n   - Test asset loading\n\n3. **Create Base Components**\n   - &#96;BaseMinigameViewModel&#96;\n   - &#96;MinigameAssetService&#96;\n   - Shared timer/score components\n\n4. **Port First Game**\n   - Follow Waypoint game pattern\n   - Use SpriteKit for rendering\n   - Implement game mechanics\n   - Test on device\n\n### Long-term:\n\n5. **Port Remaining Games** (following priority order)\n6. **Fix Broken Games** (if needed)\n7. **Create Game Selection UI** (carousel/menu)\n8. **Add Progress Tracking** (scores, completion)\n9. **Add Achievements** (optional)\n\n---\n\n## Questions to Consider\n\n1. **Game Selection UI:** How should kids navigate between games?\n   - Carousel (like current ingredient selection)?\n   - Grid view?\n   - World map (like enchantedforest)?\n\n2. **Progress Tracking:** Should games track:\n   - High scores?\n   - Completion status?\n   - Time records?\n\n3. **Unlocking System:** Should games unlock progressively?\n   - Or all available from start?\n\n4. **Audio:** For games with voice lines (Tracer3):\n   - Include all audio?\n   - Or simplify for iOS?\n\n---\n\n**Ready to start porting!** Recommend beginning with **goonpopper** or **FindPrincess** to establish patterns for the rest.",

        "contents": "- &#96;WaypointGameStandaloneApp.swift&#96; ✅\n- &#96;Views/WaypointNavigationGame/WaypointNavigationView.swift&#96; ✅\n- &#96;ViewModels/WaypointGameViewModel.swift&#96; ✅\n- &#96;Models/WaypointGameModels.swift&#96; ✅\n- &#96;Services/WaypointGameAudioService.swift&#96; ✅\n\n### Standalone Usage:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n// Uncomment @main in WaypointGameStandaloneApp.swift\n// Comment @main in abbies_world_iosApp.swift\n// Run → Game launches directly\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Integrated Usage:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n// In MainView.swift\n.fullScreenCover(isPresented: $showWaypointGame) {\n    WaypointNavigationView(\n        onDismiss: { showWaypointGame = false },\n        onComplete: { showWaypointGame = false }\n    )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Checklist for New Minigame\n\nWhen creating a new minigame, ensure:\n\n- [ ] **Standalone App File**\n  - [ ] &#96;{GameName}StandaloneApp.swift&#96; created\n  - [ ] &#96;@main&#96; commented out by default\n  - [ ] Wraps main game view\n\n- [ ] **Main Game View**\n  - [ ] Uses &#96;@StateObject&#96; for ViewModel\n  - [ ] Optional &#96;onDismiss&#96; and &#96;onComplete&#96; callbacks\n  - [ ] Works without callbacks\n  - [ ] Manages own lifecycle\n\n- [ ] **Game ViewModel**\n  - [ ] Self-contained state management\n  - [ ] Uses &#96;ServerConfig.shared&#96; for URLs\n  - [ ] Own asset loading\n  - [ ] Proper cleanup methods\n\n- [ ] **Game Models**\n  - [ ] All game types in one file\n  - [ ] &#96;ObservableObject&#96; for state\n  - [ ] Default configurations\n\n- [ ] **Audio Service** (if needed)\n  - [ ] Self-contained audio management\n  - [ ] Proper cleanup\n\n- [ ] **Asset Organization**\n  - [ ] Assets organized on server\n  - [ ] Uses &#96;ImageCache.shared&#96;\n  - [ ] Graceful error handling\n\n- [ ] **Integration**\n  - [ ] Can be added to MainView via &#96;fullScreenCover&#96;/&#96;sheet&#96;\n  - [ ] Optional callbacks work\n  - [ ] Works standalone\n\n---\n\n## Benefits of This Pattern\n\n1. **Testability:** Each game can be tested independently\n2. **Modularity:** Games don't depend on each other\n3. **Reusability:** Games can be extracted to separate apps\n4. **Maintainability:** Clear boundaries between games\n5. **Debugging:** Easy to isolate issues to specific games\n6. **Flexibility:** Can add/remove games without affecting others\n\n---",

          },
          {

          {
            "text": "## Benefits of This Pattern",

          {
            "lineNumber": 520
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Testability:** Each game can be tested independently",

        "contents": "# Music Service Coordination Plan\n\n## Paradigm: Independent Services with Lifecycle Coordination\n\nEach service (MusicService, WaypointGameAudioService) remains independent and manages its own audio session. They coordinate through lifecycle callbacks, not a central manager.\n\n## Coordination Strategy\n\n### 1. **MusicService Pauses When Game Starts**\n\n**In MainView:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n.fullScreenCover(isPresented: $showWaypointGame) {\n    WaypointNavigationView(...)\n}\n.onChange(of: showWaypointGame) { oldValue, newValue in\n    if newValue {\n        // Game is starting - pause background music\n        MusicService.shared.pauseForGame()\n    } else {\n        // Game ended - resume background music if it was playing\n        MusicService.shared.resumeAfterGame()\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**In MusicService:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nprivate var wasPlayingBeforeGame: Bool = false\n\nfunc pauseForGame() {\n    wasPlayingBeforeGame = isPlaying\n    if isPlaying {\n        pause()\n    }\n}\n\nfunc resumeAfterGame() {\n    if wasPlayingBeforeGame &amp;&amp; isMusicEnabled {\n        play()\n    }\n    wasPlayingBeforeGame = false\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. **Game Audio Stops on Dismiss**\n\n**Already handled:** &#96;WaypointGameAudioService&#96; calls &#96;stopAllAudio()&#96; in &#96;deinit&#96;, which happens when the view is dismissed.\n\n**No changes needed** - the existing pattern works.\n\n### 3. **MusicService Checks Game State Before Starting**\n\n**In MusicService.play():**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nfunc play() {\n    // Don't start if a game is currently active\n    // (We can check this via a simple flag or notification)\n    guard !isGameActive else {\n        print(\"⚠️ MusicService: Game is active, deferring playback\")\n        return\n    }\n    \n    // Normal playback logic...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Simple flag approach:**\n- &#96;MusicService&#96; subscribes to a notification when game starts/stops\n- Or: &#96;MainViewModel&#96; sets a flag that &#96;MusicService&#96; checks\n\n## Implementation: Notification-Based Coordination\n\n### Option A: NotificationCenter (Lightweight)\n\n**MusicService:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\ninit() {\n    // Listen for game lifecycle",

screenWidth - 30 &amp;&amp; value.translation.width &lt; -50 {\n                        // Swipe from right edge leftward - open drawer\n                        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.8)) {\n                            isDrawerOpen = true\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n        )\n        .onChange(of: viewModel.buttonState) { oldValue, newValue in\n            // Auto-open drawer when generation completes (transitions from generating to ready)\n            if case .generating = oldValue, case .ready = newValue {\n                // Check if we have a new preview image\n                if viewModel.previewImage != nil {\n                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.8)) {\n                        isDrawerOpen = true\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct HeaderView: View {\n    var body: some View {\n        // Header content removed - labels and settings button hidden",

        "contents": "# Phaser Minigames Porting Plan for Swift iOS\n\n**Date:** December 2025  \n**Source:** &#96;/Users/evanrobinson/abbies_world_2023/abbiesworld&#96;  \n**Target:** Swift iOS App (abbies.world.ios)\n\n---\n\n## Executive Summary\n\n**Total Games Available:** 15  \n**Functional Games:** 10  \n**Non-Functional (Need Fixes):** 5  \n**Recommended Porting Order:** Based on complexity and kid appeal\n\n**Current Status:** Waypoint Navigation game is complete. Ready to port additional minigames.\n\n---\n\n## Game Inventory &amp; Status\n\n### ✅ **Fully Functional Games (Ready to Port)**\n\n#### 1. **FindJungle** ✅\n- **Type:** Hidden Object Finder\n- **Complexity:** Medium\n- **Assets:**\n  - 4-5 backgrounds (&#96;background1.png&#96; - &#96;background5.png&#96;)\n  - 170+ object sprites (&#96;0.png&#96; - &#96;169.png&#96;)\n  - UI elements (&#96;ui1.png&#96; - &#96;ui5.png&#96;, &#96;foundImage.png&#96;, &#96;playButton.png&#96;)\n  - Magnifier tool (&#96;magnifier.png&#96;)\n- **Mechanics:**\n  - Timer-based gameplay\n  - Random object selection (5 objects to find from 25 available)\n  - Hint system with magnifier\n  - Score tracking\n  - Multiple backgrounds\n- **Swift Port Complexity:** Medium\n- **Kid Appeal:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (High - visual search is engaging)\n\n#### 2. **FindPirates** ✅\n- **Type:** Hidden Object Finder\n- **Complexity:** Medium\n- **Assets:** Similar structure to FindJungle\n- **Mechanics:** Same as FindJungle\n- **Swift Port Complexity:** Medium\n- **Kid Appeal:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (High - pirate theme)\n\n#### 3. **FindCarnival** ✅\n- **Type:** Hidden Object Finder\n- **Complexity:** Medium\n- **Assets:** 5 backgrounds + objects\n- **Mechanics:** Same pattern as other Find games\n- **Swift Port Complexity:** Medium\n- **Kid Appeal:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (Very High - carnival theme)\n\n#### 4. **FindPrincess** ✅\n- **Type:** Hidden Object Finder\n- **Complexity:** Medium\n- **Assets:** 20 objects to find\n- **Mechanics:** Same pattern\n- **Swift Port Complexity:** Medium\n- **Kid Appeal:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (Very High - princess theme)\n\n#### 5. **FindFarm** ✅\n- **Type:** Hidden Object Finder\n- **Complexity:** Medium\n- **Assets:** Similar structure",

        "contents": "**App Lifecycle:**\n- Start music playback when app becomes active (if enabled)\n- Pause music when app goes to background (optional - can continue)\n- Resume on foreground (if was playing)\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### Caching Strategy\n\n**Memory Cache:**\n- Playlist stored in &#96;MusicService.playlist: [MusicTrack]&#96;\n- Current song audio data cached in &#96;AVAudioPlayer&#96; instance\n\n**Disk Cache:**\n- Playlist metadata cached to UserDefaults (JSON encoded)\n- Audio files cached to &#96;Documents/MusicCache/&#96; directory\n- Cache key: &#96;music_playlist_&lt;timestamp&gt;&#96;\n- On startup: Check cache age, refresh if &gt; 24 hours old\n\n**Cache Invalidation:**\n- Refresh playlist on app startup if cache is stale\n- Manual refresh option in Settings (future enhancement)\n\n### Playback Logic\n\n**Normal Playback:**\n1. Play songs in order: Track 1 → Track 2 → Track 3 → ...\n2. When last song ends:\n   - If repeat mode = &#96;.all&#96;: Loop back to first song\n   - If repeat mode = &#96;.none&#96;: Stop playback\n   - If repeat mode = &#96;.one&#96;: Repeat current song\n\n**Shuffle Playback:**\n1. Create shuffled queue on shuffle enable\n2. Maintain shuffle order until shuffle disabled\n3. When song ends, play next in shuffled queue\n4. If repeat = &#96;.all&#96;, reshuffle when queue exhausted\n\n**Song Selection:**\n1. User selects song from Settings\n2. Play selected song immediately\n3. After song completes:\n   - If shuffle enabled: Continue with shuffled queue (excluding played songs)\n   - If shuffle disabled: Continue with normal queue from selected song position\n\n### Error Handling\n\n- Network errors: Use cached playlist if available\n- Audio loading errors: Skip to next song, log error\n- Missing files: Remove from playlist, continue\n- Audio session errors: Log, disable music gracefully\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nabbies.world.ios/\n├── Models/\n│   └── MusicTrack.swift (NEW)\n├── Services/\n│   ├── MusicService.swift (NEW)\n│   └── AssetsService.swift (existing - will use)\n├── ViewModels/\n│   └── MusicSettingsViewModel.swift (NEW - optional, may not need)\n└── Views/\n    └── Components/\n        ",

        "contents": "# Drawer Implementation Summary\n\n**Date:** December 2025  \n**Status:** ✅ **COMPLETE** - All phases implemented  \n**Build Status:** ✅ **SUCCEEDED**\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Complete\n\nAll 5 phases of the drawer migration have been successfully implemented:\n\n### ✅ Phase 1: Foundation\n- Created &#96;DrawerHandle.swift&#96; - Semi-transparent handle with chevron icon\n- Created &#96;DrawerView.swift&#96; - Overlay drawer container with gestures\n- Created &#96;FloatingGenerationButton.swift&#96; - Floating action button for generation\n\n### ✅ Phase 2: Layout Restructure\n- Changed &#96;MainView&#96; from &#96;HStack&#96; to &#96;ZStack&#96;\n- Carousels now full-width (100% instead of 55%)\n- Removed width constraint on &#96;CombinedColumnView&#96;\n\n### ✅ Phase 3: Drawer Integration\n- Integrated &#96;RightColumnView&#96; into &#96;DrawerView&#96;\n- Added slide animations (spring animation, 0.3s response)\n- Added backdrop dimming (20% opacity overlay)\n- Added blur effect on carousels when drawer open\n- Implemented drag gestures for swipe interactions\n\n### ✅ Phase 4: Polish\n- Drawer handle positioned on right edge, vertically centered\n- Handle has pulse animation when closed\n- Floating generation button appears when drawer closed\n- Auto-open drawer when generation starts\n- Auto-open drawer when generation completes (if preview image exists)\n- Right-edge swipe gesture (30px zone) to open drawer\n\n### ✅ Phase 5: Cleanup\n- All code compiles successfully\n- No linter errors\n- Build succeeds on iPad simulator\n\n---\n\n## Key Features Implemented\n\n### Drawer Behavior\n- **Width:** 45% of screen width\n- **Animation:** Spring animation (response: 0.3, damping: 0.8)\n- **Shadow:** Left-edge shadow (radius 12, x: -4)\n- **Background:** 85% opacity white with blur effect\n- **Rounded Corners:** Left side only (12px radius)\n\n### Drawer Handle\n- **Size:** 40px wide × 100px tall\n- **Opacity:** 35% when closed, 60% when open\n- **Icon:** Chevron (left when closed, right when open)\n- **Animation:** Subtle pulse when closed\n- **Haptic Feedback:** Light impact on tap\n\n### Gestures",

        "contents": "# Music Playback Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\nImplement background music playback system that cycles through music files from the server, with shuffle/repeat controls accessible via Settings.\n\n## Architecture\n\n### 1. **MusicService** (New Service)\n**Location:** &#96;Services/MusicService.swift&#96;\n\n**Responsibilities:**\n- Fetch music assets from server on startup (via AssetsService)\n- Cache playlist in memory and UserDefaults (for offline access)\n- Manage playback queue (shuffle/normal order)\n- Handle repeat mode (repeat all, repeat one, no repeat)\n- Play next/previous song automatically\n- Handle song selection (play specific song, then continue with queue)\n- Persist settings (music on/off, shuffle on/off, current song)\n\n**Key Features:**\n- Uses &#96;AVAudioPlayer&#96; (similar to WaypointGameAudioService pattern)\n- Implements &#96;AVAudioPlayerDelegate&#96; for track completion\n- Reactive with &#96;@Published&#96; properties for UI binding\n- Caches audio data to disk for offline playback\n- Handles audio session management\n\n**State Management:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n@Published var isPlaying: Bool = false\n@Published var currentSong: MusicTrack?\n@Published var playlist: [MusicTrack] = []\n@Published var isShuffleEnabled: Bool = false\n@Published var isMusicEnabled: Bool = true\n@Published var repeatMode: RepeatMode = .all // .all, .one, .none\n@Published var isLoading: Bool = false\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Methods:**\n- &#96;loadPlaylist()&#96; - Fetch from AssetsService, cache to UserDefaults\n- &#96;play()&#96; - Start/resume playback\n- &#96;pause()&#96; - Pause playback\n- &#96;playNext()&#96; - Advance to next song (respects shuffle)\n- &#96;playPrevious()&#96; - Go to previous song\n- &#96;playSong(_ track: MusicTrack)&#96; - Play specific song, then continue queue\n- &#96;toggleShuffle()&#96; - Enable/disable shuffle\n- &#96;setRepeatMode(_ mode: RepeatMode)&#96; - Change repeat mode\n- &#96;toggleMusic()&#96; - Enable/disable music (on/off)\n\n### 2. **MusicTrack Model** (New Model)\n**Location:** &#96;Models/MusicTrack.swift&#96;\n\n**Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nstruct MusicTrack: Codable, Identifiable, Hashable {\n    let id: String\n    let name: String\n    let url: String // Server path like \"/static/assets/music/song.mp3\"",

        "contents": "**Priority Order:**\n1. **goonpopper** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐\n   - Simple mechanics\n   - High kid appeal\n   - Good for testing porting patterns\n   - **Estimated Time:** 4-6 hours\n\n2. **FindPrincess** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐\n   - High kid appeal\n   - Reusable pattern for other Find games\n   - **Estimated Time:** 6-8 hours\n\n3. **FindCarnival** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐\n   - High kid appeal\n   - Can reuse FindPrincess pattern\n   - **Estimated Time:** 4-6 hours (after FindPrincess)\n\n### Phase 2: Medium Complexity Games\n\n4. **FindJungle** ⭐⭐⭐⭐\n   - More objects than FindPrincess\n   - Reuses FindPrincess pattern\n   - **Estimated Time:** 4-6 hours\n\n5. **FindFarm** ⭐⭐⭐⭐\n   - Same pattern\n   - **Estimated Time:** 4-6 hours\n\n6. **FindPirates** ⭐⭐⭐⭐\n   - Same pattern\n   - **Estimated Time:** 4-6 hours\n\n7. **puzzle** ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (after fixing)\n   - Different mechanics (drag-and-drop)\n   - Good variety\n   - **Estimated Time:** 6-8 hours\n\n### Phase 3: Complex Games\n\n8. **Tracer3** ⭐⭐⭐\n   - Complex geometry calculations\n   - Multiple levels\n   - Audio integration\n   - **Estimated Time:** 12-16 hours\n\n9. **enchantedforest** ⭐⭐⭐\n   - World navigation\n   - Camera system\n   - **Estimated Time:** 8-10 hours\n\n10. **FindSpace** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (after fixing)\n    - Fix Phaser version first\n    - Then port\n    - **Estimated Time:** 4-6 hours\n\n### Phase 4: Lower Priority\n\n11. **bubblepopper** (after fixing)\n12. **Tracer2** (after fixing)\n13. **MyTracerGame** (after fixing)\n14. **clippingMask** (demo only)\n15. **scripts/main.js** (main world map - may integrate differently)\n\n---\n\n## Swift Porting Architecture Recommendations\n\n### ⚠️ **CRITICAL: Standalone App Pattern**\n\n**Each minigame MUST follow the standalone app pattern** (see &#96;STANDALONE_MINIGAME_PATTERN.md&#96; - Drawer handle component\n2. &#96;Views/Components/DrawerView.swift&#96; - Drawer container component\n3. &#96;Views/Components/FloatingGenerationButton.swift&#96; - Floating action button\n\n### Modified Files\n1. &#96;Views/MainView.swift&#96; - Complete layout restructure\n   - Changed HStack → ZStack\n   - Added drawer state management\n   - Added gesture handling\n   - Added auto-open logic\n\n---\n\n## Technical Details\n\n### Drawer Positioning\n- Uses &#96;.offset(x:)&#96;         "contents": "# Project Review: Abbie's World iOS - Waypoint Navigation Game\n\n**Date:** December 2025  \n**Project Type:** Swift iOS Game for Kids  \n**Reviewer:** AI Code Assistant\n\n---\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nThis is a **well-architected Swift game** built for a child, featuring a waypoint navigation puzzle game with a multi-phase victory sequence. The codebase demonstrates good Swift/SwiftUI practices, proper separation of concerns, and thoughtful error handling.\n\n**Overall Assessment:** ✅ **Good** - Production-ready with some security and polish improvements recommended\n\n**Key Strengths:**\n- Clean MVVM architecture\n- Comprehensive error handling\n- Good use of modern Swift patterns (async/await, Combine)\n- Thoughtful asset loading and caching\n- Complete game mechanics implementation\n\n**Key Concerns:**\n- 🔴 **Security:** API key stored in Info.plist (visible in app bundle)\n- 🟡 **Performance:** Image processing on main thread\n- 🟡 **UX:** Some minor polish items for better kid experience\n\n---\n\n## Architecture Review\n\n### ✅ **Excellent Structure**\n\nThe project follows a clean MVVM pattern with clear separation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nViews/\n  ├── MainView.swift (main app)\n  ├── WaypointNavigationGame/\n  │   ├── WaypointNavigationView.swift\n  │   ├── WaypointGameCanvas.swift (SpriteKit)\n  │   └── VictorySequenceView.swift\nViewModels/\n  ├── MainViewModel.swift\n  └── WaypointGameViewModel.swift\nModels/\n  └── WaypointGameModels.swift\nServices/\n  ├── APIClient.swift\n  ├── ServerConfig.swift\n  ├── ImageCache.swift\n  ├── AssetsService.swift\n  └── WaypointGameAudioService.swift\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Strengths:**\n- Clear separation of concerns\n- Services are well-organized\n- ViewModels properly manage state\n- Models are simple and focused\n\n### Code Quality\n\n**Swift Best Practices:**\n- ✅ Proper use of &#96;@Published&#96; and &#96;ObservableObject&#96;\n- ✅ Weak references in closures (&#96;[weak self]&#96;)\n- ✅ Proper async/await usage\n- ✅ Good error handling with descriptive messages\n- ✅ Comprehensive logging with emoji prefixes for readability",

        "contents": "### Phase 5: Generation Integration (4th Reference Image)\n\n#### Step 5.1: Update startImageGeneration() Logic\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- In &#96;startImageGeneration()&#96;:\n  - Check &#96;viewMode&#96;\n  - If &#96;.fourCarousel&#96;:\n    - Require &#96;styleIndex &gt;= 0&#96;\n    - Get selected style ingredient\n    - Add style reference image to &#96;referenceImageIds&#96; array\n  - If &#96;.default&#96;:\n    - Use existing 3-image logic (unchanged)\n\n#### Step 5.2: Handle Style Reference Image\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- For placeholder styles (no actual image):\n  - Option A: Skip 4th reference image (just use style name in prompt)\n  - Option B: Create a placeholder image asset for each style\n  - **Recommendation:** Start with Option A (simpler), add images later if needed\n\n---\n\n### Phase 6: Prompt Modification (Style Integration)\n\n#### Step 6.1: Update Server-Side Prompt Generation\n**File:** &#96;Abbies World Server/src/game_engine.py&#96;\n- Check if 4th reference image is provided\n- If yes, extract style name from image path or metadata\n- Modify prompt generation to include style instruction:\n  - Example: \"Render in [STYLE] style: [generated prompt]\"\n  - Or: \"Using [STYLE] medium, create: [generated prompt]\"\n\n#### Step 6.2: Alternative: Client-Side Style Prompt\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96; (if server doesn't support)\n- If style selected, add to &#96;freeTextDescription&#96;:\n  - Example: \"Style: Crayon\" or \"Medium: Watercolor\"\n- Server will include this in prompt generation\n\n**Recommendation:** Start with client-side approach (simpler), move to server-side later if needed.\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Order (Do One Step at a Time)\n\n1. ✅ **Phase 1** - View mode infrastructure (enum, state, persistence)\n2. ✅ **Phase 2** - Settings UI (view selector)\n3. ✅ **Phase 3** - Style carousel data (placeholder ingredients)\n4. ✅ **Phase 4** - New view layout (FourCarouselView)\n5. ✅ **Phase 5** - Generation integration (4th reference image)\n6. ✅ **Phase 6** - Prompt modification (style in prompt)\n\n---",

Multiple timers running simultaneously\n   - Properly cleaned up in &#96;deinit&#96;\n   - ✅ Good: Uses weak references\n\n---\n\n## User Experience (Kid-Friendly)\n\n### ✅ **Excellent UX Features**\n\n1. **Clear Visual Feedback**\n   - Color-coded waypoints (cyan → green/red)\n   - Status messages with emojis\n   - Path visualization\n\n2. **Forgiving Gameplay**\n   - Can click unsafe waypoints anytime (no penalty)\n   - Clear error messages for wrong order\n   - Screen shake provides tactile feedback\n\n3. **Engaging Victory Sequence**\n   - Multi-phase celebration\n   - Polaroid carousel (interactive)\n   - Visual rewards for completion\n\n### 🟡 **UX Improvements for Kids**\n\n1. **Instructions Clarity**\n   - Current: \"Discover the safe waypoints to chart the path home!\"\n   - Could be: \"Find the safe path by clicking the waypoints in order!\"\n   - More direct for younger players\n\n2. **Error Messages**\n   - (0/\\(gameState.totalGoodNodes))\"\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Issue:** The &#96;else&#96; branch always shows \"0\" even when &#96;clickedGoodNodes &gt; 0&#96;.\n\n**Fix:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\ngameState.statusMessage = \"Find the first safe waypoint! ## Key Voice Integration Areas:

1. **Onboarding** (2 suggestions) - Welcome messages and feature discovery
2. **Carousel Interactions** (3 suggestions) - Selection feedback and progress updates
3. **Image Generation** (4 suggestions) - Start confirmation, progress updates, success celebration, error guidance
4. **Drawer & History** (3 suggestions) - Opening hints, item selection, empty state messages
5. **Settings** (3 suggestions) - View mode changes, music controls, song selection
6. **Waypoint Game** (4 suggestions) - Instructions, click feedback, progress, victory
7. **Victory Sequence** (1 suggestion) - Narrative storytelling
8. **Error States** (3 suggestions) - Network issues, loading states, empty carousels
9. **Accessibility** (2 suggestions) - Screen reader enhancement, contextual help

The document includes:
- Specific code locations for each suggestion
- Example voice scripts
- Implementation considerations (AVSpeechSynthesizer, TTS services, pre-recorded audio)
- Priority recommendations (High/Medium/Low)
- Technical notes on non-blocking voice, audio ducking, and accessibility

The suggestions focus on:
- **Guidance** - Helping users understand what to do
- **Feedback** - Confirming actions and progress
- **Celebration** - Making successes feel rewarding
- **Error Handling** - Friendly, helpful error messages
- **Accessibility** - Making the app usable for everyone
